items.title: The Danish "New Year's party" becomes a predictable party
items.summary: Paprika Steen and Jakob Weis stylishly end their relationship-based film trilogy with a thunderous film party. The duo has a good eye for human ceremonies and attracts the country's biggest actors, but bets on half-charged conflicts and well-sweetened finale.
items.summary_original: Paprika Steen och Jakob Weis avslutar stilenligt sin relationsbaserade filmtrilogi med en dundrande filmkalas. Duon har ett gott öga för mänskliga ceremonier och lockar landets största skådespelare, men satsar på halvladdade konflikter och väl sötad final.

items.title: That's how the parties want to help young people find housing, love and more money
items.summary: Accommodation, love and a lot of money are at the top of young people's wish list for the future. DN has asked the eight parliamentary parties how they plan to deliver. - Unfortunately, we cannot go to the election on any kind of dating guarantee, says Benjamin Dousa (M).
items.title_original: Så vill partierna hjälpa unga till bostad, kärlek och mer pengar
items.summary_original: Boende, kärlek och mycket pengar ligger i topp på ungas önskelista för framtiden. DN har frågat de åtta riksdagspartierna hur de planerar att leverera. – Vi kan tyvärr inte gå till val på någon slags dejtningsgaranti, säger Benjamin Dousa (M).

items.title: Russian rocket lit up the sky in northern Sweden
items.summary: A strange light phenomenon lit up parts of the Västerbotten sky last night. The police suspected early on that it was a Russian space rocket - something that has now been confirmed by the Kremlin.
items.title_original: Rysk raket lyste upp himlen i norra Sverige
items.summary_original: Ett märkligt ljusfenomen lyste upp delar av Västerbottenhimlen i natt. Polisen misstänkte tidigt att det rörde sig om en rysk rymdraket – något som nu bekräftats av Kreml.

items.title: Government proposes bills to strengthen efforts for accountability for Russia’s aggression against Ukraine
items.summary: Today, the Government is taking an important step to ensure accountability for Russia’s aggression against Ukraine. Through two Government Bills, it is proposed that Sweden join the Special Tribunal for the Crime of Aggression against Ukraine and accede to the Convention establishing an International Claims Commission for Ukraine. Sweden has played an active role in the establishment of both mechanisms.

items.title: Maria Malmer Stenergard visits Spain
items.summary: Minister for Foreign Affairs Maria Malmer Stenergard visited Spain on 26 March. She visited the Swedish Honorary Consulate in Torrevieja and met with expatriate Swedes, civil society organisations and political representatives. Ms Malmer Stenergard also attended the Sweden-Ukraine men’s football World Cup qualifier match.
